## Academic & Research
**MAPF-Lite: A Parameter-Efficient Multi-modal Framework for High-Fidelity Deepfake Detection**
- **Venue:** FLINS-ISKE 2026 (Published in Springer Nature)
- **Role:** Sole Architect & Lead Researcher
- **Impact:** Reduced trainable parameters from 4.4M+ down to 0.566M (99.6% reduction) while achieving 99.34% accuracy on FakeAVCeleb dataset. Outperformed AAAI 2025 SOTA models.
- **Architecture:** Frozen CLIP + Whisper backbones, Forgery Signature Gate, SRM/DCT Analysis.
